milestone: Bounded share-provider intake and Apple Maps text/link compatibility
status: Implemented; 17 new provider/intake cases, both complete Core suites and final-source Maps/Safari native product tests pass. Wider acceptance remains open.

contract.deadline_scope: One absolute intake deadline reused across attachments; completed review is not timed out.
contract.cancel: Cancel/dismissal cancels the waiting reader; one locked gate ignores late completion. Underlying NSItemProvider work is OS-owned and cannot be cancelled via loadItem.
contract.maps: Exact ancillary-only com.apple.mapkit.map-item provider stays unread; acceptance requires a separate validated web link. Review explicitly states preview omission.
contract.limits_unchanged: 4 extension items, 8 providers, one unique HTTP(S) URL, 100 KB combined text including separators, 8192 source-URL bytes. Unknown attachments and invalid/partial intake refuse the whole selection. No page or map-object fetch/decode.
contract.editable_fields: Disabled while loading/saving so late intake cannot overwrite edits.

coverage: Silent/missing/failed source, cancellation before/after start, late callback and concurrent independent reads
One shared deadline; no later attachment budget restart or partial success
Maps preview remains unread; map-only and unknown/mixed formats fail
Aggregate attributed text byte limits include separators; local-file links remain refused

maps.scope: Actual Apple Maps share of synthetic public place, review editable literal title, source HTTPS Maps URL, save while containing host quit, cold host review/Add, ordinary relaunch, exact one saved task, source/notes preservation, receipt persisted, handled draft absent, no due date and default priority. Duplicate shared text equal to source URL is handled by existing suggested-content semantics.
maps.visual: Exported real extension screenshot inspected: readable native title/source form and unobstructed Cancel/Save. Preview-omission caption lies below current keyboard viewport; full caption layout and spoken accessibility remain unverified.

builds.mac: share-intake-native-mac-final.log: BUILD SUCCEEDED; unsigned isolated Debug app and native extension, not distribution verification

safari_and_host_regression.scope: Safari Cancel saves no draft; edited link survives save with host quit and normal launch. Host review Cancel, injected disk-full Save failure/retry, durable exact one task/receipt, mailbox acknowledgement and relaunch pass. This run predates only the final loading-field disable and test wait/notice assertions; final-source source-app rerun recorded separately.

final_source.suite_result: Failed solely in temporary Shortcuts cleanup diagnostic, which missed a confirmation popover; do not count this suite as an overall pass.
final_source.notice: Maps test verifies the explicit preview-omission notice exists. Final loading/saving field disable compiled in both apps; final-source Maps/Safari review/save/relaunch pass.
final_source.cleanup_followup: share-shortcuts-cleanup-v2.xcresult passed; see cleanup scope. The earlier failed suite result is retained unchanged.

failed_iterations: First Maps probe met Maps notifications onboarding; Not Now declined without requesting permission.
Second Maps probe reproduced unsupported map-item rejection with Save disabled.
Two format-diagnostic probes retained the same failure; DEBUG was not defined in the Share target, so exact disposable bundle guard was used temporarily, then removed.
First final UI-test compilation failed because a local Add button shadowed XCTest add(attachment); renamed variable, successful rebuild before native run.

Final-source suite product cases both passed, but temporary Shortcuts cleanup failed because its Delete Shortcut confirmation was a popover, not an alert. Select-based exact-owned-item cleanup was prepared separately without changing product code.
remaining: Native Mac share-menu layout/interaction and spoken accessibility
Tablet source extension acceptance and large text
More third-party app formats; no claim of arbitrary file/map object support
All user-deferred release/signing, general older-client rollout, remote reminders and genuine OAuth provider work remain deferred

cleanup.scope: Two empty synthetic Shortcuts removed with Select and exact names; No Shortcuts baseline restored. Isolated phone app/runner uninstalled, closed unsigned Mac test app product removed, four obsolete failed probe result bundles and temporary helper files removed. Summaries/logs and final source acceptance evidence retained. No main Taskfold test process remains running. No production account, task or workspace deleted.
cleanup.native_cleanup: share-shortcuts-cleanup-v2.xcresult: one diagnostic case passed, zero failures.
failed_cleanup_attempts: First Select-based attempt queried cells before the source UI had finished appearing; waiting for the exact cells fixed the diagnostic.
cleanup.test_source: Temporary Shortcuts probe/cleanup methods absent from both owned repositories; staged test file restored to owned source after cleanup.
